text: Addressing, not suppressing or just expressing, but addressing the heart of anger. And because Jesus has made you His, you don't have to live with the pressure of settling the score. You can know that He says, "Vengeance is mine; that it's not on you to settle the score and make everything right. " That the same one who entered this world to die on the cross to remove all your sin and your shame is the same one who one day is going to return and make everything right and new.
